title: Trump Threatens Ban on US AI Data Centres Overseas
excerpt: US President Donald Trump has threatened a ban on American companies building artificial intelligence data centres in foreign countries.
body_html:
US President Donald Trump has raised the prospect of a ban preventing American companies from constructing artificial intelligence data centres outside of the United States.

During his remarks, the president offered minimal specifics regarding how such a policy would function or be implemented.

He noted that other members of his administration were learning about the potential policy concept for the very first time.
